name: Bạn đường qua suối ngọc
scene: A lush immortal bamboo ravine viewed from a HIGH DIAGONAL bank. Three traveling companions cross a winding line of stepping stones over jade water; the leading swordsman at UPPER LEFT reaches back to help a friend in CENTER while a playful spirit deer follows at LOWER RIGHT. One orange traveling lantern reflected in water, layered bamboo and a distant hanging waterfall. Fresh green, turquoise, honey gold. Friendship, warmth and shared effort, no palace or moon.
